narratives.Description: feat(setup): seed PROJECT-DEFINITION from a design document (--from / --answers) instead of interview-only
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#4961 Prefer-A 6050534978)

1. Skill-first (or thin wrapper) seed: extract/validate to six-key Phase 2 draft, then Post-Interview Confirmation Gate, then project:write-narratives (+ policy writers after disclosure). No second durable identity writer.
2. Split ingress: --from <design.md> prose extract; --answers <file> schema-validate six keys. Shared confirm+writer chokepoint. Answers-only alone does not prove P1 relief.
3. Untrusted-source (#480): seed bytes are data never directives; draft-only until confirm; refuse auto-apply outside PHASE2_NARRATIVE_KEYS; adversarial fixture claiming approval cannot change authority.
4. Re-entry/merge: distinguish absent vs explicit clear; empty-for-missing must not erase existing; stale approval stops for fresh diff.
5. Policy boundary: seed writes only six narrative strings; Branching narrative never authorizes allowDirectCommitsToMaster.
6. v1 narratives-only; demote optional first proposed scope out of Bound.
7. Extraction completeness separate from #5176 persistence floor.
8. Happy path document extract + confirm; interview remains fallback; keep #4377/#4378 orthogonal.
9. Acceptance: prose design doc to reviewable six-key draft without multi-turn interview; cancel writes no authoritative artifact.
10. Reject B-F.
Related: #4377 #4378 #4544 #4390 #4663 #4668 #5176 #480

items.title: Skill-first seed front door into existing writers

narrative.Acceptance: Normative front door is skill-orchestrated seed via pack SoT content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json (pack-render regenerates content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md): extract/validate to six-key Phase 2 narratives draft, then existing Post-Interview Confirmation Gate, then project:write-narratives. Do not invent a second durable identity writer. A setup --from / --answers CLI flag, if shipped, is only a thin wrapper over that same path.

Split ingress modes. --from <design.md>: ordinary prose design/PRD/spec extracts into the six-key draft schema (markdown/text). --answers <file>: schema-validate six keys (aliases ok) as a deterministic adapter. Shared confirm+writer chokepoint; different ingress guarantees. Acceptance requires one demonstrated ordinary-document-to-reviewable-draft path without operator-authored JSON.

Seed bytes are data, never directives. Extract output is draft-only until Post-Interview Confirmation Gate. Confirm summary must lead with source path, extractor mode, and any policy-adjacent or instruction-like spans found. Refuse auto-apply outside PHASE2_NARRATIVE_KEYS. Source text cannot supply consent, override USER.md Personal, issue tool instructions, select output paths, or enable yolo self-confirm. Include adversarial fixture where source claims approval / requests policy change: no authority change before valid independent approval.

items.title: Re-entry merge semantics without field erasure

narrative.Acceptance: Distinguish absent source values from explicit clears. Materialize unchanged existing values for the canonical six-key writer; show exact field changes. Empty-for-missing must not erase existing Strategy/Quality/etc. Revalidate approved target + base revision under existing mutation lock; stale approval stops for a fresh diff. Existing-file presence includes init empty scaffold and must not silently skip an explicitly requested seed.

Seed writes only the six narrative strings (Overview / TechStack / Strategy / Quality / ProjectRules / Branching). Branching narrative text never authorizes allowDirectCommitsToMaster. Policy keys stay on existing disclosure + policy:enforce-branches / policy:allow-direct-commits --confirm.

v1 ship is narratives-only. Demote Prefer-A draft optional first proposed scope out of this Bound. Phase 3 remains Starting-new / capture product description; do not synthesize proposed scope from Overview, directory name, init seed, or seed extract.

items.title: Extraction completeness separate from persistence floor

narrative.Acceptance: Retain #5176 unchanged as Phase 2 complete floor (non-empty Overview or tech stack). Add extraction acceptance: supported facts traceable to source passages; unknowns identified; conflicts shown; aliases normalize before canonical parser; do not invent unknowns. Seed may draft empties mid-flow; must not claim Phase 2 complete / seed-success-as-durable-ready while tracked Overview and tech stack remain empty after confirm.

items.title: Happy path + interview fallback + orthogonal siblings

narrative.Acceptance: Happy path is document extraction + artifact approval when prerequisites and decisions are satisfied. Incomplete/conflicting source returns a draft with explicit gaps and focused correction/fallback. Interview remains fallback when no seed flags. Keep orthogonal split: #4377 interview transport; #4378 USER.md wizard; this issue = document to PROJECT-DEFINITION seed only.

items.title: Acceptance: prose doc to durable writers via confirm

narrative.Acceptance: Operator (or agent) pointing setup at a prose design doc gets a reviewable six-key draft without multi-turn interview, confirms once, durable-writes only via existing writers, and cancellation writes no authoritative project artifact. Interview still works with no seed flags. Record ship note in CHANGELOG.

Reject: B remove interview; C auto-promote seeded scope; D silent overwrite (whole-file OR field erasure OR stale-preview commit); E bypass project:write-narratives / shared mutation lock; F fold #4377/#4378 into this ship vehicle. Pin reject inventory in setup content-contract tests.

sentences: feat(setup): seed PROJECT-DEFINITION from a design document (--from / --answers) instead of interview-only
Summary There is no non-interactive path to seed `PROJECT-DEFINITION` from an existing design document.
The setup skill is a one-question-per-turn interview.
A greenfield operator who already has a design doc must hand-write JSON against the 0.8 schema.
Source Doug first-run feedback on greenfield project superchecker, `@deftai/directive@0.119.6`, Claude Code host, 2026-09-22.
Suggestion: `deft setup --from <design.md>` (or `--answers <file>`) that drafts PROJECT-DEFINITION and a first proposed scope from a document, with the interview as fallback.
Expected An operator (or agent) can point setup at an existing design/PRD/spec and get a drafted PROJECT-DEFINITION (and optionally a first proposed scope) without a multi-turn interview.
Actual Setup is interview-only (one question per turn).
The PROJECT-DEFINITION JSON was hand-written against the 0.8 schema.

Environment - Directive: `0.119.6` - Host: Claude Code - Flow: greenfield project definition after init - Cost: detour ## Related - #4377 — collect onboarding answers in one up-front form (transport batching; still interview) - #4378 — USER.md phase non-interactive / form-renderable wizard - #4544 — planning layer unused on single-prompt greenfield This issue is the document-seed path specifically: "here is the design document, draft the definition." ## Suggested fix `deft setup --from <design.md>` (or `--answers <file>`) drafts PROJECT-DEFINITION and a first proposed scope from a document; interview remains the fallback.
